title: Offgrid Review
subtitle: Review the evidence, select every compatible action, and export decision JSON. Nothing is changed from this page.

global_actions.label: Defer for later
global_actions.description: Leave the item unresolved for a future review.

global_actions.label: Needs another reviewer
global_actions.description: Route the item to a person with more context.

global_actions.label: No action needed
global_actions.description: Record that the item was reviewed without follow-up.

queues.title: Pending decisions
queues.description: Review each item and select every compatible follow-up.
queues.empty: Nothing to review in this queue.
queues.question: Which actions should be taken?

actions.label: Accept the proposal
actions.description: Carry the proposed values into the apply pass.

actions.label: Request changes
actions.description: Keep the item open and describe the required edits.

actions.label: Add a follow-up
actions.description: Create a separate follow-up after the main decision.

actions.label: Close permanently
actions.description: Close and archive the linked item.

queues.title: Review backlog
queues.description: This queue demonstrates an explicitly exclusive decision.
queues.question: What is the backlog outcome?

actions.label: Promote to active work
actions.description: Move the item into the active queue.

actions.label: Keep in backlog
actions.description: Leave the item in its current queue.

queues.title: Plan review
queues.description: Review long-form sections, a table, and a portable diagram in the same workbench.
queues.question: What feedback should return to the agent?

actions.label: Approve the direction
actions.description: Keep the proposed structure and proceed to implementation.

actions.label: Revise the direction
actions.description: Return the plan with targeted changes.

actions.label: Capture follow-up work
actions.description: Keep the direction and record additional work separately.
